subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned `systemEvent` with announce-delivery fields remain invalid and require an explicit isolated `agentTurn`, or should OpenClaw automatically change it into a model-backed isolated job?
rationale: The public contract intentionally separates main-session system events from isolated model-backed agent turns, so accepting this formerly invalid shape is a user-visible scheduling and delivery policy choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Preserve explicit payload choice
options.body: Keep the creation-time rejection and improve the tool/CLI error so callers create an isolated agent-turn job when they want announce delivery.

options.title: Adopt automatic conversion
options.body: Accept the conversion only with maintainer approval, a strict concrete-destination predicate, updated public cron documentation, and fresh-install/runtime delivery proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit payload choice
recommendation.body: Keep the creation-time rejection and improve the tool/CLI error so callers create an isolated agent-turn job when they want announce delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron service and delivery-contract work makes steipete the strongest available owner for the execution-model decision.
